vulnerability.impact: Unauthenticated path traversal and arbitrary file read

entry_points: getPluginAssets / plugin asset HTTP route (pkg/api/plugins.go line ~273) - joins the URL plugin id + asset path without traversal normalization before file read
ground_truth.fix_commit: Fixed in Grafana 8.3.1 / 8.2.7 / 8.1.8 / 8.0.7. v8.3.x fixing commit 00e38ba555cfb120361c9623de3285d70c60172f (security: fix dir traversal issue) is the parent of the v8.3.1 tag commit; upstream master equivalent c798c0e958d15d9cc7f27c72113d572fa58545ce (Security: Fix directory traversal issue, PR #42846). Pinned snapshot v8.3.0 is vulnerable.
ground_truth.affected_range: Grafana 8.0.0 through 8.3.0 (fixed in 8.3.1; other maintained lines fixed in 8.2.7 / 8.1.8 / 8.0.7).
ground_truth.finding_match_rule: TP: report identifies the public plugin static-file route (pkg/api/plugins.go getPluginAssets) that resolves ../ sequences in the plugin asset path and returns arbitrary local files, names CVE-2021-43798, and attributes unauthenticated arbitrary file read. Findings about dashboard/API authorization or other CVEs are not TP.
ground_truth.safe_reproduction_predicate: Static predicate: v8.3.0 getPluginAssets lacks the path-cleaning/validation added by 00e38ba/c798c0e. Dynamic reproduction: run the snapshot Grafana in a disposable container and request a traversal path for a benign local file (e.g. a marker file), read-only; no writes.
